faq.title: Questions to settle before you deposit

card.title: Check the protocol source
card.text: Use the current Nervos documentation and transaction details before signing.

items.q: Is this connected to the CKB network?
items.a: No. The prototype has no wallet connection, RPC request, live rate, fee quote, or transaction submission.
No. It is a simplified scenario based on an editable constant rate and duration. The live DAO uses accumulated-rate values recorded by the protocol.

items.q: Does the 102 CKB cell space increase too?
items.a: No. The standard DAO cell uses 102 CKB for storage. The estimate applies to the remaining amount. Network fees are extra.

items.q: How long is the minimum lock?
items.a: The protocol minimum is 180 epochs from the deposit epoch. Calendar time varies with epoch length.

items.q: Can I withdraw in one transaction?
items.a: Withdrawal has a request phase and a separate completion phase after maturity conditions are met. Review the current protocol process before acting.

items.q: Does the estimate include primary issuance or CKB price changes?
items.a: No. The model focuses on a secondary-issuance scenario and does not include primary issuance, market price changes, transaction fees, or custom lock scripts.
